plan.title: EXP-DRAFT-027 RFQ Hidden in eRFX Draft

steps.note: Open the eRFX create screen to build the saved draft.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test tenant.
Apply the setting whose effect on the draft's available stages is being tested.
Apply the additional stage-configuration prerequisite from the case.
Give the draft a stable title so it can be located and reopened.
Configure the initial stage so the draft can be saved.
Add the required line item for a valid draft.
Complete the pricing sheet for the line item.
Commit a schedule before saving the draft.
Create the saved eRFX draft required by the scenario.
Confirm the draft save did not produce an application error.
Navigate to the Events list to reopen the saved draft.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Verify the newly saved draft appears in Drafts.
Open the created draft from the Drafts list.
Open the Add Stages menu whose RFQ availability is under test.
Assert that RFQ is not offered in the saved draft.
